# Getting Started with Java in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}

This tutorial shows you how to write and run Hello World program in Java with {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %}. It also covers a few advanced features, which you can explore by reading other documents in this section.

For an overview of the features available for Java in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}, see [Java Language Overview](/docs/languages/java.md).

If you run into any issues when following this tutorial, you can contact us by entering an [issue](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-java-pack/issues).
